Police foil attempt to sell 4-day-old baby in sting operation

Balapur Police conducted a sting operation that foiled an attempt to sell a 4-day-old baby. A woman was arrested for her involvement. The police claimed the woman had agreed to sell the baby for ₹50,000. The incident occurred on Tuesday at a local market in Balapur.
